payload.reason: The baseline is clearly defined in the evidence as the performance measure for Model A, which was trained on LibriSpeech data and achieved a WER of 96.21%.

claims.text: The baseline for this work is a WER of 96.21% achieved by Model A, trained on LibriSpeech data.
Model A is taken as the baseline due to the high mismatch between speech and song audio, indicating the challenges in transcribing song audio.
